overview: AI providers adopt a shared robots.txt signal for content‑training preferences
OpenAI releases a community safety report and tightens teen firearm content rules
Google’s space‑based AI satellite demonstrates TPU operation and generates its first output

top.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
top.summary: OpenAI will honor a common signal in robots.txt that lets sites express AI training preferences to multiple providers, simplifying compliance and building on IETF standards.

top.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
top.summary: OpenAI announces a Community Safety Report and adds stricter limits on firearm‑related queries for minors, aiming to improve violence‑prevention safeguards.

top.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
top.summary: Google’s Suncatcher satellite, equipped with four TPUs and the Gemma‑4 model, successfully generated a haiku in orbit, testing inference workloads under space conditions.

top.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
top.summary: Intel’s shares fell 28% after a weak Q4 outlook, wiping $12 billion from the U.S. government’s stake and highlighting AI‑driven PC market pressures.

top.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
top.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic commit to a shared “policy token” in robots.txt, enabling publishers to opt out of AI scraping across multiple crawlers.

top.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
top.summary: Google confirmed its Suncatcher satellite’s TPUs are operational, producing a space‑themed haiku and moving toward twin‑satellite AI data centers in 2027.
